name: workflows
description: Sets up one OpenSpec workflow in a project with one command: seven change-type schemas (feature, bugfix, refactor, spike, upgrade, setup, rapid) with a router between them, a design subagent, a rewritten openspec/config.yaml that carries forward what you wrote, and guarded installation of the three plugins the flows call. Matt Pocock's skills drive each step, six of Addy Osmani's agent-skills cover threat modelling, design challenge, defect review, performance, current docs, and the quality bar, and impeccable does all surface work. Re-runnable, with --check for read-only drift reporting. Also routes a piece of work to the right schema.
